model_basis: Trusted developer designation; full-history model inherited, no switch or performance claim.

premises.P30-PROFILE: Fixed symmetric Borel probability nu on [-1,1], independent of delta,W,center and branch; mu1=0, mu2 in [0,1].
premises.P30-CENTERS: Same center interval [a+delta,b-delta], arbitrary probability center measure with mean m and variance V=W-mu2*delta^2; 0<=delta<min(L,H).
premises.P30-KERNEL: Inherited fixed k in C3([a,b]), k_second>0 and k_third<0 including one-sided continuous endpoint derivatives. No recertification here.
premises.P30-KERNEL_C2: k in C2([a,b]), including continuous one-sided endpoint derivatives, suffices for second-order local regularity.
premises.P30-CONVEXITY: Inherited k_second>0 gives positive F_W by the exact weighted-curvature integral.
premises.P30-EXACT-ROOT: Exact F(0,w_j)=0 for an interior w_j in (0,LH); zero-width endpoint signs and approximate roots remain inherited numerical support, not a new enclosure.
premises.P30-STORED-POINT: Finite stored reference w_hat is interior with A=F(0,w_hat) retained; all exact identities refer to the frozen real-valued model before finite arithmetic error.
premises.P30-UNITS: E,delta,c in eV; W,V in eV2; k,F,A in s^-4; d,mu2,Xi dimensionless; metric(-,+,+,+), proper seconds; existing source-real normalization fixed.

claims.claim: The pushforward of rho product nu under E=y+delta*z is supported on [a,b], has mass1, mean m and actual variance W=V+mu2*delta^2.
limits: Common fixed profile applied independently at every center; no truncation or renormalization.

claims.claim: At fixed delta, the common-profile mixture class is nonempty exactly when mu2*delta^2 <= W <= (L-delta)*(H-delta)+mu2*delta^2.
limits: delta in [0,min(L,H)); width endpoint excluded; statement is for the specified center class.

claims.claim: For any fixed probability measure nu, including atomic measures, averaged kernel center derivatives through order3 are the corresponding integrals of k derivatives; f_second>0 and f_third<0 follow from the inherited strict signs.
limits: No new derivative-sign certificate; no density smoothness is assumed or needed.

claims.claim: Along support-preserving center paths the full second width derivative is k_second*(Y_delta^2+mu2)+k_prime*Y_delta_delta at zero; first and mixed derivatives have no direct profile-moment contribution.
limits: Right derivatives at zero and derivatives on a physical half-rectangle only; no kernel extension.

claims.claim: The two center measures at alpha and m+V/ell, and at m-V/h and beta, attain the upper and lower response envelope within the fixed-profile center-mixture class. Quadratic Hermite bounds prove extremality and strict contact uniqueness for interior V.
limits: Not an unrestricted photon moment envelope for positive delta.
Degenerate V endpoints are handled by their unique moment measures.
Hermite remainder is proved by Rolle multiplicity, not assumed as an unexamined inherited moment theorem.

claims.claim: Every exact interior zero-width root has a support-preserving physical half-rectangle on which the response is right-C2; F_W is positive by a weighted integral of averaged k_second.
limits: Existence only of a small physical neighborhood; no numerical width bound or exact-root enclosure.

claims.claim: At zero width F, B=F_delta, C=F_W, M=F_delta_W and N=F_W_W are common to all specified profiles. Explicit formulas use only k,k_prime,k_second at the existing endpoint and interior center.
limits: General interior W formulas; no new node, derivative or kernel evaluation in this contribution.

claims.claim: The seven fixed-center-variance endpoint, center and probability-motion contributions in G_delta_delta are profile independent at zero.
limits: Averaging and actual-to-center variance corrections are kept separate and counted once.

claims.claim: K_nu=G_geometry+mu2*scriptH-2*mu2*C, hence K_nu-K_uniform=(mu2-1/3)*(scriptH-2*C), scriptH=p*k_second(e)+q*k_second(x).
limits: Zero-width partial identity at fixed actual W; no finite-width response equality.

claims.claim: For an exact simple interior root, c=-B/C and d_nu=-(K_nu+2*M*c+N*c^2)/(2*C)=W_second(0+)/2. The actual physical right-C2 root and its o(delta^2) expansion exist.
limits: Exact-root existence is conditional; numerical endpoint evidence is not an interval certificate.
No quantitative remainder, certified finite width or higher-order coefficient claim.

claims.claim: c_nu=c_uniform and d_nu=d_uniform+(mu2-1/3)*(1-scriptH/(2*C)); two fixed symmetric profiles with equal mu2 share the second-order root expansion and differ by o(delta^2).
limits: Same center interval, same branch, same exact initial root and frozen physical inputs.
No identity at finite positive width; no general profile ordering or universal total-d sign.

claims.claim: The isolated actual-variance contribution is d_V=mu2 and averaging is d_average=-mu2*scriptH/(2*C). The common d_V cancels from the two-threshold gap; the remaining profile dependence is the difference of the scriptH/(2*C) ratios.
limits: For mu2>0 the averaging contribution is strictly negative; at mu2=0 it vanishes.
Component signs do not determine total d or gap-profile response sign.

claims.claim: At a finite stored reference with nonzero A=F(0,w_hat), the general c,d describe the same F_nu=A level, and the profile transfer law holds for that level with A common at zero.
limits: Exact-real identities at a reference point; actual Decimal arithmetic and physical-input uncertainty are separate.
A is retained and not overwritten by zero; no root refinement or error bound.

claims.claim: The residual-preserving numerator identities use Q_delta_delta=2*(1-mu2): c=-(Ncal_delta+2*R*A)/(Ncal_W-A), d=-(Ncal_dd+2*Ncal_dW*c+Ncal_WW*c^2-2*(1-mu2)*A)/(2*(Ncal_W-A)).
limits: At A=0 only, residual terms may be removed.
Uniform mu2=1/3 recovers the retained PHYS29 4A/3 correction.

claims.claim: Atomic profiles remain admissible for the theorem; mu2=0 forces nu=Dirac0 and mu2=1 forces the symmetric two-endpoint profile. The same shrinking center interval remains in both cases.
limits: A narrow actual profile support does not authorize expanding the center interval.
No automatic photon absolute continuity.

claims.claim: For delta>0 an absolutely continuous profile with merely integrable density yields the stated mixture photon density. General atomic or singular profiles provide no universal density guarantee.
assumptions: nu absolutely continuous for positive density claim
limits: Density claim needs the additional absolute-continuity assumption.
No claim that every convolution with atomic nu is singular; general center laws can change that behavior.

claims.claim: The uniform density 1/2 on [-1,1] and triangular density 1-|z| on [-1,1] have mass1, mean0 and exact second moments1/3 and1/6 by analytic polynomial integration.
limits: Analytic moments only; no profile numerical coefficient or quadrature execution in this contribution.

claims.claim: For an analytic quadratic kernel all profiles have F=a0+a1*m+a2*(m^2+W), C=a2, B=K=M=N=0 and simple-root c=d=0; scriptH=2*a2, d_average=-mu2 and d_V=mu2 cancel.
assumptions: a2 nonzero and an interior root for root statement
limits: This analytic limit drops strict k_third<0 and corresponding strict extremizer uniqueness.
An affine kernel has C=0 and is excluded from the simple-root formula.
No toy numerical program was run.

claims.claim: All d contributions and the profile susceptibility Xi=1-scriptH/(2*C) are dimensionless; fixed normalization scales cancel in derivative ratios.
limits: No authorization to change normalization, physical model or relative J components.

claims.claim: Proposed next question: at what next local order do same-mu2 fixed symmetric profiles with different higher moments first produce different threshold shifts?
assumptions: Additional smoothness and higher-order validity would need a new contract
limits: PROPOSED_NOT_RUN; no higher-order theorem, coefficient, kernel evaluation or numerical execution performed.
